# Source

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A source of information from others that is used as input for developing your own ideas and knowledge in a PKM system.

## Scope note

- Includes a person, article, webpage, book, video, podcast, webinar, or course,

## Broader

- [Knowledge](../Knowledge/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
